text:
Alex: Ok team — holiday challenge! Holiday Hydration + Mug Bingo + 'Bad Carol' micro-competition. Bring a holiday mug pic and a 1-line terrible carol. I'll compile bingo winners and give a tiny sticker pack :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye: Rules: post mug pic, write 1-line carol, and mark a square on the bingo card below.
Sam: Love it. What's the bingo card? How do we mark squares?
Alex: Just reply with the square text you claim and tag me. First to complete a row/col/diag wins. no edits after claiming. I'll trust the honor system.
Maria: Here's the card! (no image, sorry)
```
B I N G O
Hot cocoa mug|Ugly sweater mug|Travel thermos|Handmade pottery|Plant-themed mug
Festive animal mug|Glitter rim|Local cafe logo|Office-branded mug|Tiny lid
DIY paint job|Reused gift box|Mug with lid|Oversized mug|Double-walled
Color-changing mug|Holiday pun|Gnome mug|Sock + mug combo|Cactus mug
Mug full of snacks|Mismatched pair|Chip on rim|Family heirloom|Glow-in-the-dark
```
Jin: I'm claiming 'Cactus mug' — got mine on my desk rn 🌵 @Alex
Alex: ✅ Jin claimed 'Cactus mug' at 10:07. Remember to post pic!
Jin: pic: (image) — ok here's a bad carol: 'Oh silent night, my Wi-Fi's low, Santa paused the download flow.' :notes:
Sam: 😂 that's peak bad. Posting my mug now — travel thermos with stickers. Claim 'Travel thermos'. Carolo: 'Deck the halls with recycling bins, fa la la la lag.'
Maria: I'm claiming 'DIY paint job' (I painted mine last year). Carolo: 'Jingle bells, my laptop dings, meeting starts in three more rings.'
OpsBot: Poll time! React with :thumbsup: if you want a tiny sticker, :heart: if you want a holiday playlist share, :tada: for both. Poll ends in 24h.
Sam: :thumbsup: — stickers pls
Alex: Also mini 'Bad Carol' leaderboard so far: 1) Jin 2) Sam 3) Maria. Keep 'em coming. Prize = dungeon-themed sticker + honorary label in #random for a week.
Maria: Also, can we do a mini caroling lunchtime at 12:30 on Friday? Anyone in person can duet.
Jin: I'm in if there's eggnog. :raised_hands:
Alex: Noted. Ok everyone — post mug pics and claims. I'll update the thread and mark winners. Happy holidays, team! :evergreen_tree: :coffee:
